summary: Barclays PLC filed a Form 6-K comprising several routine disclosures, including total voting rights, admission of shares, and—critically—a series of share buyback transactions under a program announced 10 February 2026. The company repurchased for cancellation 5.92m, 5.82m, 3.30m, and 4.58m shares at volume-weighted average prices between 381.38p and 406.31p per share. The buyback is an open-market execution via J.P. Morgan Securities plc, with all shares cancelled, reducing issued share capital to ~13.718bn shares. This is a capital return to shareholders through share repurchases, not a tender offer or issuer self-tender. Watch for ongoing pace of repurchases and impact on earnings per share.
